items.question: In the UAE, within how many hours must an employer report a work-related injury or occupational illness to the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE)?
items.fact: Employers must report work injuries to MoHRE within 48 hours.

items.question: In the UAE, how many days of sick leave per year may an employee take for a non-work-related illness after the probation period?
items.gold: Up to 90 days per year, consecutive or intermittent.
items.fact: Employees may take up to 90 days sick leave yearly after probation.
